what: Thin-fence rc dispatch does not require a default abort arm
scenario_or_breakage: If design-postplan-emit.sh exits with an unexpected non-listed rc such as 126, 127, or signal-derived status after set +e capture, a case with only the listed arms can fall through and continue silently
suggested_fix: Add a mandatory *) arm to every merged fence that prints the rc and aborts, and pin it in scripts/test-design-structure.sh
